snippet.title: Monster Train 2 - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Your train has arrived - the beloved deckbuilder is back!

Five brand-new clans, game-changing room & equipment cards, all-new modes and challenges, and countless ways to dominate your run. It’s Monster Train 2.

Monster Train 2 is OUT NOW on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch, and via Xbox Game Pass.

More Info: https://www.bigfangames.com/games/monster-train-2
